name: Deception 0.3.105 — Public and Beta Compatibility
description: The Deception branch adds Mimics, Spies, Foggers, Blackmail, Surveillance, Reconnaissance and Trade Secrets. Mimics cost 1 star; Spies and Foggers cost 5 stars. Spies and Spymaids have 2 movement. Blackmail costs a flat 2 stars per use. Trade Secrets pays 1/2/3 stars per missing tier 1/2/3 technology per met opponent. Matching builds required for online play.
